release_read.basis: Record revenue $218.3m above the $210-216m guide, non-GAAP EPS $0.84 above $0.75-0.82, record $102.5m operating cash flow, and a Q4 guide of $227-233m with product revenue $127-133m (about +14% QoQ again) and 'even stronger' Q4; tempered by four straight negative prints driven by the 2027 RDIMM unit narrative, which this release does not settle.

release.headline: Rambus Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

vs_bar.consensus_source: company guide midpoint $210-216m (no street consensus found in time), https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000917273/000119312526431918/rmbs-ex99_1.htm
company guide midpoint $0.75-0.82; Nasdaq forecast $0.65 (1 estimate, fallback, likely a different basis)

key_line.metric: product revenue and Q4 product guide
key_line.detail: Q3 product revenue $114.3m; Q4 product guide $127-133m (midpoint +13.7% QoQ), consistent with the Montage read-through of rising Q4 interconnect demand.

guidance.detail: Q4 revenue $227-233m, product $127-133m, royalties $68-74m, non-GAAP EPS $0.84-0.92; street Q4 consensus not verified in time, so 'raised' is relative to Q3's level, not to the street.

call.detail: Call held 2:00pm PT; its content (2027 RDIMM commentary) was not reviewed in the time available. After-hours traded -0.6%, which suggests the call did not add to the release.

public_reaction.summary: No analyst action for 2026-10-27 found in the time available; headline coverage limited to the release itself (record revenue, beat vs guide).

tape_read.note: Robust reference 91.35 vs prev close 90.32 (+1.14%), far inside the 13.1% implied move and below the +5% release read; after-hours was -0.6%, pre-market range 87.50-92.44, 20 prints, 5 in the last 30 minutes, last at 09:14, not stale. Position is +3.0% vs 13:30 entry (88.38). The market is reading the beat through the 2027 RDIMM worry, as on the last four prints.

thesis_check.note: Thesis was a product beat from the Montage read-through; product revenue and the Q4 product guide (+~14% QoQ) and the revenue/EPS beats confirm it, but the reaction is muted.

expected.open_lag_note: Pre-market is active (print a minute ago), so the open should hold the small +1.1% move; the gap is too small for a reliable fade, and the wide 87.50-92.44 range plus a negative after-hours make the direction after the open close to a coin flip.

recommendation.reason: De cijfers zijn beter dan de eigen prognose en het vierde kwartaal ziet er sterk uit, maar de markt reageert lauw (ongeveer +1% voorbeurs, nabeurs zelfs licht lager), zoals bij de vorige vier publicaties door de zorg over 2027. De positie staat ongeveer 3% in de plus; neem die bij de opening, zoals de standaardregel. Er is geen nieuw nieuws of analistenactie dat vasthouden rechtvaardigt.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de voorbeurskoers voor 09:30 doorloopt naar boven 92,44 (de voorbeurshoogste) of analisten hun koersdoel verhogen, dan vasthouden tot de slotkoers.
